gizmo.title: Hōʻike i nā kiko wela
gizmo.description: Loaʻa i nā haumāna nā wahi pololei ma kekahi kiʻi ma ke kaomi ʻana, ka paʻi ʻana a i ʻole ka neʻe ʻana i ke keʻa kuhi papa kikokiko. Ka hoa kaha helu ʻia o ka palapala ʻāina kiʻi.

configure.title: Kiʻi
configure.description: Ke kiʻi a nā haumāna e huli ai.

configure.title: Kikokikona pani
configure.description: Wehewehe i ke kiʻi no ka poʻe hiki ʻole ke ʻike iā ia. ʻAʻole loa e hōʻike ʻia ma ke ʻano he poʻo inoa.

configure.title: Poʻo inoa
configure.description: He poʻo inoa pōkole ʻike ʻia ma luna o ke kiʻi.

configure.title: Nīnau
configure.description: Ka mea i noi ʻia i nā haumāna e loaʻa ma ke kiʻi.

configure.title: Nā pane
configure.description: He pōʻai lōʻihi inoa ʻia kēlā me kēia pane ma ke kiʻi. He pakeneka o ke kiʻi ke kūlana a me ka nui, ana ʻia mai kona kihi hema luna. ʻOiai e hoʻoponopono ana, kahakaha ʻia kēlā me kēia pane ma ke kiʻi.

advanced.title: Nā hoʻāʻo
advanced.description: ʻEhia manawa e hiki ai i kekahi haumāna ke hoʻāʻo. ʻO ka 0, palena ʻole.

advanced.title: Nā hala i ʻae ʻia
advanced.description: ʻEhia hala e hoʻopau ai i kekahi hoʻāʻo. ʻO ka 0, palena ʻole, a loaʻa i nā haumāna kahi pihi Hoʻopau.

advanced.title: Hiki ke ʻōpiʻi
advanced.description: Hōʻike i kēia nīnau ma ke ʻano he lālani e wehe a pani ai. Ke wehe ʻia kekahi, pani ʻia nā nīnau ʻōpiʻi ʻē aʻe ma kona ʻaoʻao.

advanced.title: Hoʻomaka me ka ʻōpiʻi
advanced.description: Ke hiki ke ʻōpiʻi, e hoʻomaka ma ke ʻano he lālani pani e hōʻike ana i ka nīnau a me kona kūlana wale nō.

advanced.title: ʻAno kaha helu
advanced.description: OER Schema: ke ʻano kaha helu no kēia loiloi (e laʻa nā ʻai, hua palapala, pakeneka, pau ʻana).

advanced.title: Pahuhopu aʻo
advanced.description: OER Schema: ka pahuhopu aʻo e pili ana i kēia loiloi.

developer.title: Inoa o ka hoʻokolohua
developer.description: Inoa hoʻokolohua i hāʻawi ʻia no ka hoʻohana ʻana ma nā kaiapuni xAPI no ka hōʻike ʻana i kēia mea

developer.title: Papa
developer.description: OER Schema: ka papa i manaʻo ʻia ai kēia loiloi.
